capabilities: Render Bases as a Notion-style table
Edit cells inline with pill select, calendar and checkbox editors
Open notes in a centered page panel with editable title, properties and Live Preview body
Resize columns and sort from column headers
Compute per-column calculations over filtered rows
extras: Only note.* frontmatter properties are editable; file.* and formula.* columns are read-only. An optional CSS snippet restyles the base toolbar. Not affiliated with Notion Labs.
intentEvidence: A custom Bases view for Obsidian that renders your databases as a Notion-style table
problem: Bases' built-in table is plain: no colored value pills, no hover row buttons, and no way to edit cells or open notes without leaving the table.

relations.evidence: renders your databases as a Notion-style table

summary: Custom Bases view that renders databases as a Notion-style table with hover OPEN buttons, colored value pills, inline cell editing and a page panel.
